posts.hook: A month of AI benchmark hype finally got a number that isn't self-reported
posts.caption: a new independent benchmark finally separates claude fable 5.1 from gpt-6 astra with a real score, the same week a new extraction test catches both gpt-5 and gemini-3 failing completely, two newspapers sue openai and microsoft over their own journalism, and the us government's new arcade site draws a threat from tetris. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
